question: Among the sets whose expansion type is Commander, which set has the highest total number of cards including promotional and related supplemental products but excluding Alchemy modifications? Indicate the id of the set.

WITH commander_sets AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM sets
    WHERE type = 'expansion' AND name LIKE '%Commander%'
),
-- Суммируем количество карт для каждого сета, исключая Alchemy модификации
card_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        set_id,
        SUM(
            CASE 
                WHEN printings LIKE '%C13%') OR 
                     printings LIKE '%C14%') OR 
                     printings LIKE '%C15%') OR 
                     printings LIKE '%HOU%') OR 
                     printings LIKE '%THB%') OR 
                     printings LIKE '%PLC%' THEN 0
                ELSE 1
            END
        ) AS total_cards
    FROM cards
    GROUP BY set_id
)
-- Связываем сеты с их количеством карт и находим сет с максимальным количеством
SELECT cs.id
FROM commander_sets cs
JOIN card_counts cc ON cs.id = cc.set_id
ORDER BY cc.total_cards DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: What is the percentage of incredibly powerful cards in the set Coldsnap?
gold_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL AND T1.cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.id) FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN sets AS T2 ON T2.code = T1.setCode WHERE T2.name = 'Coldsnap'
predicted_sql:
-- Calculate the percentage of "incredibly powerful" cards in the set "Coldsnap"
WITH coldsnap_cards AS (
    SELECT 
        id, 
        name, 
        type, 
        text 
    FROM 
        cards 
    WHERE 
        setcode = 'Coldsnap'
),
powerful_cards AS (
    SELECT 
        id 
    FROM 
        coldsnap_cards 
    WHERE 
        -- Check for keywords indicating powerful effects
        text LIKE '%destroy%' 
        OR text LIKE '%damage%' 
        OR text LIKE '%draw %card(s)%' 
        OR text LIKE '%hand//head%'
        OR text LIKE '%put %into %play%'
        OR text LIKE '%search %your %library%'
        OR text LIKE '%that %controller %controls%'
        OR text LIKE '%your %opponent%s %does%'
)
SELECT 
    ROUND((COUNT(*)::numeric / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM coldsnap_cards)) * 100, 2) AS percentage
FROM 
    powerful_cards;
